skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — create a 30-second promo video from my product description — and get ready...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Generator Free Browser.

- Instantly generate 30-second promo videos from text descriptions or images directly in your browser without software installs.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 200MB; AI handles all editing and creation.
- Seamless authentication with free, temporary credits—no signup required to start.
- Cloud rendering delivers ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports key workflows: quick edits, batch style processing, and iterative previews/refinements.
- Designed for content creators and marketers looking for effortless video production.
